entities.name: Query protein MMP-9
observations: The 708-residue sequence exactly matches reviewed rat matrix metalloproteinase-9 UniProt P50282 by sequence hash, with 100% identity and coverage.
The sequence has an N-terminal signal peptide at residues 1-19 and is therefore routed through the secretory pathway.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight 78,610 Da, theoretical pI 5.66, predicted charge at pH 7 of -17.5, GRAVY -0.445.
Pfam detects Peptidase_M10 at residues 116-216 and 377-445, three fibronectin type-II domains at 231-272, 289-330, and 348-389, a propeptide/PT region at 475-510, and a hemopexin domain at 524-568.

The sequence contains the conserved cysteine-switch propeptide motif near residues 98-105 and a catalytic-site region around residue 403, consistent with a latent zinc-dependent matrix metalloproteinase.
The protein is secreted and functions in extracellular matrix proteolysis; curated homolog annotations include collagen IV/V and fibronectin degradation and roles in leukocyte migration.
Curated subunit annotations report monomer or homodimer forms and a heterodimer with LCN2 for mammalian MMP-9.
